name: Igala

summary.text: The Igala live mainly in southern and eastern Kogi State, in the angle where the Niger and Benue rivers meet. Their historic capital is Idah, on the Niger, seat of the Attah Igala, ruler of the Igala Kingdom.

areas.note: A mixed LGA. Other groups, including the Bassa, also live here.
A mixed LGA, shared with Ebira communities.
Wikipedia names Iyelen in Lokoja LGA. Lokoja is a mixed LGA.
